teaser: I say it as I remember it; the agent checks it against the record before anyone reads it. Five confirmed, five corrected, two not found.
core_idea: Voice memos can now say things as remembered, because the writing agent checks every claim against repositories, documentation, the web and the author's own old writing before publishing; in the last eight articles five claims were confirmed, five corrected and two not found, and the articles say which; the habit began with ChatGPT Deep Research in February 2025, whose O2 essay cited the author's own 2012 posts as evidence; peer review has moved from the crowd after publishing to the record before it, thinking out loud becomes safe, the checking runs both ways, and every article carries provenance for journalists and their agents to check again.
